articles.title: Judge Limits Government Search for Noncitizens on Voter Lists
articles.summary: A federal judge limited a DHS effort to find noncitizens on voter lists in nine states before the midterm elections.

articles.title: Strong Typhoon Champi Brings Wind and Rain Near Taiwan
articles.summary: Typhoon Champi cancelled hundreds of flights and closed schools in Taiwan as it passed near the island.

articles.title: U.S. Border Officers Are Searching More Phones and Laptops
articles.summary: Searches of travelers' phones and laptops at U.S. borders are up more than 32 percent this year.
